visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young woman in a vibrant blue wig with a green star clip, dressed in a blue and white sailor-style school uniform. She is indoors in what appears to be a hobby room with shelves of merchandise. She looks directly at the camera with large blue contact lenses and adjusts her hair with her right hand. (2) She puts on clear-rimmed glasses in a medium shot. At the bottom of the frame, a horizontal split-screen shows a digital VTuber avatar and an "Authenticity Certificate" for a character named "Saba Sameko," listing specific height and birth details. The lighting is bright and even across the room. (3) The scene cuts to the woman holding a pink measuring tape vertically. Graphic text overlays "HGT: 35 cm" with a fish emoji. She gestures towards the camera with her free hand, maintaining a neutral, slightly inquisitive facial expression while looking through her clear glasses in a well-lit indoor environment. (4) A close-up shot shows a hand measuring a small, stylized anime-girl figurine in a blue shark hoodie with white teeth details. The pink measuring tape indicates a height of about 15 cm. The background is a cluttered desk area with a pink keyboard and various other hobbyist collectibles. (5) The woman reappears wearing a fake black mustache and clear glasses, looking visibly confused or disappointed. She holds the measuring tape again in a medium shot, pointing at the measurement. A red "X" and "15CM" appear on screen, indicating a failure to meet the expected height requirement. (6) A new phase shows a close-up of the woman measuring a large, round plushie of the same shark-girl character. The plushie's head reaches the 35 cm mark on the pink measuring tape. The background remains the brightly lit indoor setting with soft shadows visible on the furniture. (7) She holds the large plushie close to her chest with both arms, looking satisfied and smiling slightly. A green checkmark and "35CM" overlay appear next to her. The camera is static at a medium shot, capturing her upper body, the uniform, and the plushie with high detail. (8) There is a sudden, high-contrast jump cut to a static close-up of a tan chihuahua dog with very large, wide eyes, staring intensely into the camera lens against a simple pink and white background. The visual quality of this segment is lower, suggesting a screen-captured meme image. (9) The final phase returns to the cosplayer, who now looks extremely shocked with wide-open eyes and a gaping mouth. Translucent mathematical equations and a floating VTuber image appear around her head as she stares intensely at the camera, conveying a sense of sudden realization or confusion.
